title: Prove no free completion of the stated fresh-input fourteen-call schedule (no new κ)
body:
The retained fresh-original PR4813 architecture cannot be completed by a fixed free decoder, even after imposing the correct swap-sector premise. Its fifth input crosses at most two paid calls along every stated path, whereas its requested three-axis target has support 8^f. This closes that complete raw architecture, not every fourteen-call program.

The package emits an honest 15-bank caller for four three-call ports and one two-call closing port, including original ownership and all raw outputs. Its exact fifth-input support polynomial is `1+z+3z^2`, z=2^f. Every fixed bounded-column free decoder multiplies support by only a width-independent constant B, contradicting the target for sufficiently large f. The argument also supplies explicit witnesses within either chosen swap sector and tolerates recording-only taps of the emitted expansion.

Changed-premise controls keep the scope precise: a 15-call closing upgrade reaches depth 3, and a different 14-call closing feed using the updated fourth-port output reaches depth 4 and produces different raw observations. Neither changed caller is declared complete or excluded by this theorem. The per-input depth condition is not summed into a universal 3W call bound.

Validation: normal/optimized registered replay passes. All 40 independent input columns at width 1 over Q(i) and all 320 at width 2 over F17 match a separate raw-port oracle on all 15 output banks. The literal invoice, all-prefix depth certificate, separately tensorized branches, actual sector inputs/target supports and both changed-premise controls pass. Exact source pins, committed-byte/source-history and whitespace checks pass. Sources and notices remain unchanged; no full native, selected cold replay or Lean build is claimed.

Credit Pierre-Loic Doulcet/hexapode PR4813 for the named architecture, Dugongue PR4743 for valid raw ports, Yiyang PR4710, lee-phys PR4688, and Jacob Alan Sussman PR4628 with eumemic and Swapnil Jain for the engine and related support method. The elementary support method is not claimed as new. This is the global raw-decoder continuation of PR5004; it changes no selected frontier or scientific acceptance record.

Prepared by Cinna Davis with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in research, proof explanation, implementation, verification and writing. Apache-2.0. No independent human or proof-assistant verification claimed.
